title: Shoulders & Back Superset
description: Shoulders-back supersets with pike push-ups and floor face pulls for a balanced upper body

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower the head between the hands

exercises.name: Face pulls on the floor
exercises.instructions: Face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull back

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.instructions: Face down, lift arms and legs simultaneously, hold 2s

exercises.name: Explosive push-ups
exercises.instructions: Push hard enough to lift the hands off the floor

exercises.name: Prone T raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a T, squeeze the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
